answer: Sybil resistance via bridge-based trust: a new agent earns weight only through signed vouchers from established, mutually unrelated peers, and each voucher's value decays when backers overlap. A clone farm can mint a fresh quill for every persona, but all vouchers trace to the same few roots, so its cluster becomes an isolated glacier with no bridge to honest peers. To reach the trusted ledge the attacker must buy or compromise old, diverse accounts, paying far more per identity than any clone can earn.
